items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: His name was Alphonse Spears. I guess you didn't want to say Spears band, the name of the Egyptian band.

ctx.x: Yeah but who is Gibson that they named the band?
He just named the band that he named, the name Alphonse Spears, just named the band Gibson, the Gibson band.
Yeah but there's no such person as Gibson huh? No. Just made that up huh? Yeah. That's a kick. The Gibson band.
